errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that 'other services' is the largest sector, while 'industry' has the largest share in the turnover diagram.
The description incorrectly states that 'industry' has 21% of employment when it actually represents 51%.
The description does not clearly explain the overall purpose of the chart or the significance of the data presented.
The description omits the fact that the sectors are not sorted by size in the diagrams, which is an important visual feature.
